description_en: Cancels the automatic snapshot policy for one or more cloud disks
description_zh: 取消一块或者多块云盘的自动快照策略
kebab_example: aliyun ecs cancel-auto-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --disk-ids d-bp14k9cxvr5uzy540000_,_d-bp1dtj8v7x6u08iw0000_,_d-bp1c0tyj9tfli2r80000 --auto-snapshot-policy-id sp-bp14yziiuvu3s6jn0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policy and cloud disks. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 自动快照策略和云盘所在的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policy and cloud disks. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照策略和云盘所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The IDs of the cloud disks. To cancel the automatic snapshot policy for multiple cloud disks, specify the cloud disk IDs in a JSON array in the format of "d-xxxxxxxxx", "d-yyyyyyyyy", … "d-zzzzzzzzz". Separate multiple cloud disk IDs with commas (,).
parameters.description_zh: 目标云盘ID。当您需要取消多块云盘的自动快照策略时，多块云盘ID用一个格式类似 "d-xxxxxxxxx", "d-yyyyyyyyy", … "d-zzzzzzzzz" 的JSON数组表示，云盘ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
parameters.help_en: The IDs of the cloud disks. To cancel the automatic snapshot policy for multiple cloud disks, specify the cloud disk IDs in a JSON array in the format of "d-xxxxxxxxx", "d-yyyyyyyyy", … "d-zzzzzzzzz". Separate multiple cloud disk IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 目标云盘ID。当您需要取消多块云盘的自动快照策略时，多块云盘ID用一个格式类似 "d-xxxxxxxxx", "d-yyyyyyyyy", … "d-zzzzzzzzz" 的JSON数组表示，云盘ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: disk_ids

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the automatic snapshot policy that you want to cancel.
- Default value: empty. If you use the default value, note the following items:
  - If only one automatic snapshot policy is applied to the cloud disk, the automatic snapshot policy is canceled.
  - If more than one automatic snapshot policy is applied to the cloud disk, the `OperationDenied.TooManyAutoSnapshotPolicies` error code is returned and the request fails. Specify the `autoSnapshotPolicyId` parameter to specify the ID of the automatic snapshot policy that you want to cancel.
parameters.description_zh:
需要取消的自动快照策略 ID。
- 默认值为空。如果使用默认值，您需要注意：
  - 如果云盘上的自动快照策略数量是 1，则会取消这条自动快照策略。
  - 如果云盘上的自动快照策略数量大于 1，则会返回`OperationDenied.TooManyAutoSnapshotPolicies`错误码，导致请求失败。建议您使用`autoSnapshotPolicyId`明确指定需要取消的自动快照策略 ID。
